stem.text: During the semi-conservative replication of DNA, the double helix is unwound by an enzyme.
Which diagram shows how the strands are copied?

A.alt: Diagram of DNA replication with labelled DNA polymerase, lagging strand, leading strand and DNA ligase, and 5′ and 3′ ends marked on the strands.

B.alt: Diagram of DNA replication with labelled DNA polymerase, leading strand, lagging strand and DNA ligase, and 5′ and 3′ ends marked on the strands.
